WITH observatory_shares AS (
    SELECT
        observstation,
        COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
        100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_pct
    FROM telescopes
    GROUP BY observstation
),
averaged AS (
    SELECT
        observatory_shares.*,
        AVG(share_pct) OVER () AS average_share_pct
    FROM observatory_shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescopes,
    AVG(share_pct) AS average_share_pct,
    AVG(share_pct - average_share_pct) AS average_excess_share_pct
FROM averaged
WHERE share_pct > average_share_pct;

assumptions.assumption: The average share is the unweighted mean across observatories represented in the telescopes table; observatories with no telescopes are not included because they have no row in that table.
